tool_args.rationale: The five rows span sink gradients substantially, so a low-gradient-span probe is unnecessary; however, the open square-root branch sign remains unresolved among plausible siphon laws. The targeted branch probe is the smallest useful paid observation before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a four-parameter siphon model to the five existing rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations leave limited room to distinguish competing nonlinear response laws and confirm the open branch sign.
The pilot signatures point to a static monotone-concave response, not a coupled memory ODE requiring trajectory data.
It is explicitly irrelevant and costly.
